savings_or_continuation_provisions.quote: are hereby designated and empowered to exer-cise, without approval, ratification, or other action by the President, the authority vested in the President by sections 301, 301a, and 301c of title 37, United States Code.

transfer_provisions.quote: The Secretary of Defense, the Secretary of Commerce, the Secretary of Health and Human Services, and the Secretary of Homeland Security with respect to the Coast Guard when it is not operating as a service in the Navy
transfer_provisions.to: same four Secretaries, widened to 37 U.S.C. 301 and 301c

conclusion: EO 13294 (signed 2003-03-28, 68 FR 15917-15919; the held file also prints the preceding EO 13293) re-delegates the President's 37 U.S.C. 301, 301a and 301c authority to four Secretaries (sec. 1), revokes EO 11157 and EO 11800 as amended (sec. 2) and disclaims private rights (sec. 3). It states no effective date (effective on signing). It has no savings or exception clause; the 'Nothing in this order shall be construed to impair... Executive Order 12776' sentence belongs to EO 13293. The revocation of EO 11800 is paired with a successor delegation of the same function, so the function is carried forward by a different instrument.
